description: This file defines an abstract base class for Drupal migration source plugins, including methods for iteration, row processing, high-water mark management, and configuration handling.

classes.name: SourcePluginBase
classes.description: Abstract class providing core functionality for Drupal migration source plugins, including iteration, row processing, high-water mark management, and configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing configuration, migration, and settings for high-water mark, cache, and change tracking.

methods.name: initializeIterator
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize and return an iterator over source data.

methods.name: getModuleHandler
methods.description: Retrieves the module handler service, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Prepares a source row, invoking hooks and handling skip logic.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns the iterator over source data, initializing it if needed.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current source row.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the serialized key of the current source row.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the iterator to the beginning.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next source row, processing and filtering as needed.

methods.name: fetchNextRow
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the next row.

methods.name: aboveHighWater
methods.description: Checks if a row's high-water property exceeds the stored high-water mark.

methods.name: rowChanged
methods.description: Determines if a row has changed since last import based on hashing.

methods.name: getCurrentIds
methods.description: Returns the current source IDs.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the count of source records, using cache if enabled.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves the cache object for counts.

methods.name: doCount
methods.description: Performs the actual count of source records.

methods.name: getHighWaterStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the key-value storage for high-water mark.

methods.name: getHighWater
methods.description: Gets the current high-water mark value.

methods.name: saveHighWater
methods.description: Stores a new high-water mark value.

methods.name: getHighWaterProperty
methods.description: Returns configuration for high-water property.

methods.name: getHighWaterField
methods.description: Returns the field name used for high-water mark.

methods.name: preRollback
methods.description: Resets high-water mark during rollback.

methods.name: postRollback
methods.description: Post-rollback hook (no operation).

methods.name: getSourceModule
methods.description: Returns the source module name if configured.
